{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Dark straight-leg jeans, full length with a slight stretch, in indigo (#2F3A52), mid-weight stretch denim
Fine-knit crew-neck sweater, relaxed fit, hip length, in sage green (#8FA597), merino-cotton blend
Long-sleeve cotton tee, fitted, slim cut, as a base layer under the sweater, in cream (#F2E8D0), soft jersey
Short trench-style jacket, straight cut, hitting at the hip, in warm sand (#C9B08A), water-resistant cotton twill
Leather ankle boots, low stacked block heel (about 3 cm), cushioned insole, rounded toe, in cognac (#9A5B34), smooth leather with a rubber sole
Wool-blend scarf, long and lightweight, in soft mustard (#D4A94F), woven wool and viscose
Crossbody bag, compact with a zip closure, in tan (#B88555), pebbled leather
Thin cotton socks, ankle length, in cream (#F2E8D0), with cushioned soles

This outfit is built for nine hours of walking on cobblestones in cool autumn air, so every piece prioritizes comfort and easy layering. The tee, sweater and light jacket let her adjust to +12 °C as the day warms and cools, and the scarf adds warmth at the neck without bulk. The sage green, sand and mustard sit in a warm, earthy range that flatters her golden-blonde hair, warm skin and grey-green eyes. The cushioned, low-heeled boots grip uneven stones, and the hands-free crossbody keeps her free to take photos and explore."}
